recipe.title: Rice and hoisin chicken salad
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Ripe Deli, via My Food Bag.

method.s: Pat chicken dry and slice horizontally into steaks.
Place into a pot with a pinch of salt and just enough water to cover the chicken.
Cover with a lid and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, turn off heat and leave, covered, for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, remove chicken from poaching liquid, reserve liquid, and roughly shred chicken using two forks.
Return shredded chicken to the pot and toss with hoisin sauce.

In a bowl, combine soy sauce, honey, vinegar and sesame oil. Toss in bok choy slices, broccoli, radish slices, soy dressing, mung beans and cooked rice. Season to taste with soy sauce and set aside to serve.
Divide salad between bowls and top with chicken. Sprinkle with nori and sesame seeds.
